tool.name: LppAssignLeaflets
tool.description: : Wrapper of the LiPyphilic AssignLeaflets module for assigning lipids to leaflets in a bilayer.

param.name: input_top_path
param.label: input CRD,GRO,MDCRD,MOL2,PDB,PDBQT,PRMTOP,PSF,TOP,TPR,XML,XYZ file
param.help: Path to the input structure or topology file. Format: [input].[format]

param.name: input_traj_path
param.label: input ARC,CRD,DCD,ENT,GRO,INPCRD,MDCRD,MOL2,NC,PDB,PDBQT,RESTRT,TNG,TRR,XTC,XYZ file
param.help: Path to the input trajectory to be processed. Format: [input].[format]

param.name: outname_output_leaflets_path
param.label: output CSV,NPY name
param.help: Path to the output leaflet assignments Format: [output].[format]

param.name: sele
param.label: Take tool settings:
param.help: Select where tool settings are to be read from

param.name: properties
param.label: Configuration file
param.help: File containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: jsonstr
param.label: JSON string
param.help: JSON string containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: lipid_sel
param.label: lipid_sel
param.help: Selection string for the lipids in a membrane. The selection should cover **all** residues in the membrane, including cholesterol.

param.name: midplane_sel
param.label: midplane_sel
param.help: Selection string for residues that may be midplane. Any residues not in this selection will be assigned to a leaflet regardless of its proximity to the midplane. The default is `None`, in which case all lipids will be assigned to either the upper or lower leaflet.

param.name: midplane_cutoff
param.label: midplane_cutoff
param.help: Minimum distance in *z* an atom must be from the midplane to be assigned to a leaflet rather than the midplane. The default is `0`, in which case all lipids will be assigned to either the upper or lower leaflet. Must be non-negative.

param.name: n_bins
param.label: n_bins
param.help: Number of bins in *x* and *y* to use to create a grid of membrane patches. Local membrane midpoints are computed for each patch, and lipids assigned a leaflet based on the distance to their local membrane midpoint. The default is `1`, which is equivalent to computing a single global midpoint.

param.name: ignore_no_box
param.label: ignore_no_box
param.help: Ignore the absence of box information in the trajectory. If the trajectory does not contain box information, the box will be set to the minimum and maximum positions of the atoms in the trajectory.
